label: HISTORICAL DEVELOPMENT
question: Can prior-date paired shots on target from the R10 model improve the exact scores of the R13 domestic-form model within the same outcome?
population: Use exactly the signed R30 Europa and Conference men's league-phase fixtures and date windows, separately. Rebuild their R13 matrices and full R10 shot matrices using the pinned original R7 settings and the original R10 fit and prior-date R6 and supplemental box scores. The R10 AFC-only supplement is outside the two competitions. Check exact fixture, prices, outcomes and matrix summaries against both signed archives. The older model fits and choices end before July 2025. The 2026/27 holdout has entered previous project research.
method: Use R10 only when both sides have prior-date shot history in its original signed exposure. For each WDL outcome retain the R13 matrix mass and use the within-outcome score probabilities from full R10. Mix this projected grid with R13 at weights 0, .25, .5 and 1. Keep the original signed scores at weight zero or absent prior shot exposure. Positive mixtures rank the cells with the existing stable score sorter. All mixture arms retain the independent R13 direction, actual line and totals choice and the same archived market. Keep unchanged R10, R7 and market as separate controls. Check conservation of each R13 score-grid outcome mass within 2e-12.
selection: Use the first half of 2025/26 to nominate a fixed weight for each competition. Admit weights with at least as many first and three hits as R13. Sort by first hits, three hits, lower exact log loss and smaller weight. Confirm that one nominated weight on the remainder of 2025/26. Retain it only if both score hit counts tie or exceed R13 there, otherwise select R13. Replay all fixed weights, the selected weight and every control on the registered 2026/27 holdout. Report original scope, prior shot coverage, paired gains and losses, date-cluster intervals, unchanged R13 WDL and real-line totals denominators, and how many third-list misses already covered the actual direction.
forward: A positive selected weight with a net holdout gain in either score metric and no loss in the other qualifies for an independent research comparison. Use the earliest complete registered future round for which both exact signed R7-based inputs, same-market cutoff and actual prior shot evidence can be reconstructed and frozen before kickoff. Do not deduce a missing market line, revise already displayed scores, or count historical results toward stage acceptance. A failed screen ends the recipe at development diagnostics. Formal stage review uses the originally registered actual-display population and real 90-minute results.
